framework.name: National Health Education Standards (NHES, 2nd ed., 2007) performance indicators, with the Illinois Learning Standards for Physical Development and Health (Goals 22 and 23), NGSS life science and C3 history where a unit teaches them
framework.note: NHES codes read standard.grade-span.indicator (1.2.1 = Standard 1, by grade 2, indicator 1); Illinois health is cited at the goal level only (Goal 22, Goal 23), because the goal is what we can state with certainty; history-of-medicine units cite C3 history and NGSS where they honestly fit. Alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification.
